postgres.description: A PostgreSQL connection. The URL carries no password: a password in it is refused, and `passwordEnv` names the environment variable that holds it.

description: The configuration of `audit migrate --config`, which applies the index schema. Secrets are never in this file: a field named ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

reader.description: A role to grant what the query service needs: usage on the schema and select on its tables, now and later, and nothing else. The role must already exist.

title: audit migrate
